transcript.text: Mara, here's what I found. Yesterday after the full-site rehearsal, I conducted an RF survey and discovered that the audience handheld wireless microphones called for in the draft package interfere with the emergency-communications channel. I've already worked through this with the appropriate parties and the approved workaround is to replace the audience handheld wireless microphones with a host-led call-and-response using exactly two wired microphones. This means the draft package's plan for audience members to use handheld wireless microphones cannot proceed as written. I want to stress that my written survey report hasn't been filed with the event office yet, but the interference issue is confirmed and the workaround is approved at the technical level.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Mara, here's my critical update on rights clearance. I received the publisher's final clearance email this morning, and it contains two key restrictions that directly affect the draft package. First, only two of the four selected songs — 'Afterglow' and 'Northbound' — are licensed for the finale. The other two songs are not cleared. Second, the license expressly prohibits the use of projected lyrics. This means the draft package's plan to project lyrics for audience sing-along cannot proceed as written. I should also note that I have not yet entered this clearance email into the festival rights register, but the publisher's decision is final and binding.
